# Symbol-font run text

`symbol-text.pptx` is a synthetic one-slide deck on the same package shell as `symbol-bullets.pptx`;
it contains no private corpus material. Each shape holds one run with one `a:latin` typeface.

| Shape | `a:latin` | Stored text | Drawn |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 10 | Symbol | `a+b ` U+F0B3 ` p` | `α+β ≥ π` (Adobe Symbol table, both slot ranges) |
| 11 | Wingdings | `l` U+F0E0 | `●` U+F0E0 (a named slot, then an unnamed one kept as stored) |
| 12 | Arial | `a+b` | `a+b` (not a symbol face) |
